title: Bianchi-I Cosmology with Radiation in Asymptotically Safe Gravity
summary: We study the late-time evolution of an anisotropic Bianchi-I universe with radiation in the framework of asymptotically safe gravity. We first discuss the radiation-dominated universe for the perfect fluid with the equation of state $p=ρ/3$, and find that the classical evolution involves logarithmic terms, which lead to a slow approach toward isotropy. The quantum effects introduce subleading corrections that soften the anisotropy in the intermediate stage. Next we discuss the universe with magnetic fields.
